WITH inserted AS (
			INSERT INTO users (id, name, email, password_hash, last_login, metadata, age, balance, profile_picture_url)
			VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
			RETURNING id, name, email, password_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at, last_login, metadata, age, balance, profile_picture_url
		),
		audited AS (
			INSERT INTO users_audit (id, parent_id, version, snapshot, valid_from)
			SELECT $10, id, 1, to_jsonb(inserted.*), NOW() FROM inserted
		)
		SELECT id, name, email, password_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at, last_login, metadata, age, balance, profile_picture_url FROM inserted

WITH closed AS (
			UPDATE users_audit
			SET valid_to = NOW()
			WHERE parent_id = $1 AND valid_to IS NULL
		),
		updated AS (
			UPDATE users
			SET name = $2, email = $3, password_hash = $4, is_active = $5, created_at = $6, updated_at = $7, last_login = $8, metadata = $9, age = $10, balance = $11, profile_picture_url = $12
			WHERE id = $1
			RETURNING id, name, email, password_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at, last_login, metadata, age, balance, profile_picture_url
		),
		audited AS (
			INSERT INTO users_audit (id, parent_id, version, snapshot, valid_from)
			SELECT $13, updated.id,
			       COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM users_audit WHERE parent_id = updated.id), 0) + 1,
			       to_jsonb(updated.*),
			       NOW()
			FROM updated
		)
		SELECT id, name, email, password_hash, is_active, created_at, updated_at, last_login, metadata, age, balance, profile_picture_url FROM updated
